command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
# Open MPI refuses to run as root without these, and a container runs as root. Omitting them
# is how the first probe died: Open MPI killed the ranks with no useful message.
export OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
export OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== CP2K_DATA_DIR must be wired, or cp2k aborts on its first calculation =="
# conda-forge installs 68 basis-set and pseudopotential files under share/cp2k/data and sets no
# CP2K_DATA_DIR; the env's Dockerfile exports it (aarchsci#30). Verified present here rather
# than assumed, because an unset value fails deep inside the first SCF.
printf 'CP2K_DATA_DIR\t%s\n' "${CP2K_DATA_DIR:-<UNSET>}"
test -n "${CP2K_DATA_DIR:-}" || { echo "FAIL: CP2K_DATA_DIR unset -- cp2k cannot find its basis sets"; exit 1; }
test -d "$CP2K_DATA_DIR" || { echo "FAIL: CP2K_DATA_DIR=$CP2K_DATA_DIR is not a directory"; exit 1; }
printf 'data_files\t%s\n' "$(ls "$CP2K_DATA_DIR" | wc -l)"

echo "== the MPI binary and the regtests must both be present =="
command -v cp2k.psmp >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: cp2k.psmp absent (the MPI build)"; exit 1; }
command -v mpiexec   >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: mpiexec absent"; exit 1; }
T=/opt/conda/etc/conda/test-files/cp2k/1/tests
test -d "$T" || { echo "FAIL: regtests not installed at $T"; exit 1; }
printf 'regtest_root\t%s\n' "$T"

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
# Prefer the matcher registry the PACKAGE installs; fall back to the pinned staged copy from
# the matching tag. Which one was used is printed, because they could in principle differ.
MDIR=$(dirname "$(find /opt/conda -name matchers.py -path '*tests*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)")
if [ -n "$MDIR" ] && [ -f "$MDIR/matchers.py" ]; then
  printf 'matchers_source\t%s (installed with the package)\n' "$MDIR"
else
  MDIR=/tmp
  printf 'matchers_source\t%s (staged, pinned, from tag v2026.2)\n' "$MDIR"
fi
# TEST_DIRS likewise: prefer the package's copy, fall back to the pinned staged one.
TD=$(find /opt/conda -name TEST_DIRS -path '*tests*' 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$TD" ]; then printf 'test_dirs_source\t%s (installed)\n' "$TD"
else TD=/tmp/TEST_DIRS; printf 'test_dirs_source\t%s (staged, pinned, tag v2026.2)\n' "$TD"; fi
CP2K_BIN=cp2k.psmp CP2K_TESTS="$T" CP2K_MATCHERS="$MDIR" CP2K_TEST_DIRS="$TD" \
  python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
